top.name: The Architecture
top.rules_text: For the rest of the fight: whenever you prepare a glyph it is also prepared on all tiles within 1, and your glyphs deal double damage.

bottom.name: Absolute Territory
bottom.rules_text: For 2 turns, enemies within 3 of where you stand deal half damage, take 2 damage for each tile they walk there, and cannot teleport in or out.

changes.value: Rest of fight: glyphs you prepare also prepare on all tiles within 1, glyph spells cost 1 less, and glyphs deal double damage.
For 2 turns, enemies within 3 of where you stand deal half damage, take 3 per tile they walk there, and cannot teleport in or out.

upgrades.description: The Greater Architecture: each prepare also banks Weave.

changes.value: Rest of fight: glyphs spread to radius 1, glyph spells cost 1 less, glyphs deal double damage, and you bank 1 Weave per glyph prepared.

upgrades.description: Absolute Territory (Wide): the zone lasts 3 turns.

changes.value: For 3 turns, enemies within 3 of where you stand deal half damage, take 3 per tile they walk there, and cannot teleport in or out.

upgrades.description: The Master Architecture: glyphs spread to radius 2.

changes.value: Rest of fight: glyphs spread to radius 2, glyph spells cost 1 less, glyphs deal double damage, and you bank 1 Weave per glyph prepared.

upgrades.description: Absolute Territory (Total): enemies inside are also Named.

changes.value: For 3 turns, enemies within 3 of where you stand are Named (half damage, cannot move), take 3 per tile they walk there, and cannot teleport in or out.

upgrades.description: The Seventh Layer: glyphs trigger three times and spread to radius 2.

changes.value: Rest of fight: glyphs spread to radius 2, glyph spells cost 1 less, glyphs deal triple damage, and you bank 1 Weave per glyph prepared.

upgrades.description: The Unwritten Law: a permanent, total domain.

changes.value: For the rest of the fight, enemies within 4 of where you stand are Named (half damage, cannot move), take 4 per tile they walk there, and cannot teleport in or out.
